# Vendored JavaScript

Unmodified builds of the libraries the admin uses, shipped with the package so that no Node.js and no network access are needed to install it. Both are MIT-licensed.

| File | Package | Version | Source |
|------|---------|---------|--------|
| `turbo.js` | [`@hotwired/turbo`](https://turbo.hotwired.dev) | 8.0.23 | `dist/turbo.es2017-esm.js` |
| `stimulus.js` | [`@hotwired/stimulus`](https://stimulus.hotwired.dev) | 3.2.2 | `dist/stimulus.js` |

To update one, replace the file with the same file of the new version from the npm package, and change the version here.
